intro: Quick, fun polls for the home page button. There's no right answer. They get students thinking and give the class results to talk about. Rotate one per day.

questions.question: Would you rather live near a volcano or a fault line?
Would you rather explore the deepest ocean trench or walk on Mars?
Which would you rather find while digging: a diamond, a dinosaur bone, or gold?
What's the scariest natural hazard: earthquake, tornado, hurricane, or avalanche?
Which Idaho place would you rather visit: Craters of the Moon, Bruneau Dunes, or Thousand Springs?
Would you rather survive a week in the desert or a week in the Arctic?
If you could have one survival tool, would it be a compass, a water filter, or a fire starter?
Which season has the best weather in Idaho?
questions.note: No options given in the doc

questions.question: Would you rather watch a geyser erupt or the northern lights?
Have you ever felt an earthquake? Yes, no, or not sure.
Would you rather be a geologist, a meteorologist, an oceanographer, or an astronomer?
What's the coolest rock: obsidian, pumice, geodes, or granite?
Would you rather have a pet rock or a pet trilobite (if it were alive)?
options: a pet trilobite (if it were alive)

questions.question: Snow day or sunny day?
Would you rather hike the Tetons or float the Snake River?

questions.question: Would you rather know the exact day of the next big earthquake or never know?
